newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-TSYMBALAR OUT FOR RUSSIA'S WORLD CUP GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TSYMBALAR OUT FOR RUSSIA'S WORLD CUP GAME.

text.p: Russia will be without Spartak Moscow captain and inspirational playmaker Ilya Tsymbalar for Saturday's World Cup group five qualifier against Luxembourg.

Tsymbalar, whose club side face champions Alania Vladikavkaz in a title decider a week later, is sidelined by cartilage trouble that has dogged him all year and could be out of action for some time, a Russian league spokesman said on Wednesday.

A squad heavy with expatriates travelled to Germany on Tuesday to prepare for a match Russia must win comfortably if they are to open up a lead over Israel, who are level on points and travel to bottom-placed Cyprus on Saturday
